protocol.approval: Owner explicitly requested the original official dataset split on 2026-11-03
protocol.reporting: Official validation metrics; not a new blind test

config.camera_initialization: official nuScenes-supervised Simple-BEV RGB encoder; trainable during DINO distillation
config.data_protocol: official 700-scene train / 150-scene validation; no local blind test claim
config.camera_probe_pooling: fixed height mean, 128 channels; fused probe also 128 channels
config.losses: image_weight * image DINO + bev_weight * radar-soft-masked BEV DINO + motion_weight * radar velocity reconstruction auxiliary; optional depth
config.segmentation_readout_loss: official SimpleLoss(pos_weight=2.13); not legacy class-balanced BCE

final_validation.metric_definition: global valid-cell intersection / union; sigmoid.round threshold
